question.title: Copy the Relay Team
question.content:
A relay team is a linked list of runners. Each runner has a bib number val, a pointer next to the runner they hand over to, and a pointer backup to the teammate who stands in for them, which may be any runner on the team, themselves included, or null.

Return the first runner of a deep copy of the team. The copy must be made of new nodes only: no next or backup pointer in it may lead back to an original node, and its pointers must have the same shape as the original.

Test case format:

A team is shown as a list of [val, backup_index] pairs in order along next, where backup_index is the position of the backup runner, or null if there is none. The method only receives the first runner.

 

Example 1:

Input: team = [[6,2],[11,null],[8,0]]
Output: [[6,2],[11,null],[8,0]]

Example 2:

Input: team = [[15,1],[21,1]]
Output: [[15,1],[21,1]]
Explanation: The second runner is their own backup, and so is the copy of that runner.

Example 3:

Input: team = []
Output: []

 

Constraints:

  • 0 <= team.length <= 1000
  • -104 <= Node.val <= 104
  • Node.backup is null or points at a runner on the team.
